influences.name: Rock 'n' roll musicians (old rock 'n' roll songs)
influences.context: The group also frequently stepped away from whatever tune they were fiddling with to play some of the old rock 'n' roll songs that inspired them when they were younger.

influences.name: Smokey Robinson
influences.context: With The Beatles' second track was heavily inspired by Smokey Robinson. "All I've Got to Do" was recorded in a single day…
